before: A localized East Asian family name and a missing bold or italic East Asian face resolve to the packaged CJK face in PDF export.
after: A localized name resolves to the supplied face of its English name; a missing bold or italic face resolves to the family regular face.
reason: Only derived layout changes. Shared nodes, canonical UTF-16 offsets, operations, and package serialization remain unchanged. Peers with the same fonts lay out the same lines.
